units.source_text: 女人仰起脸，欲言又止，立刻又回到了沉默之中。

en.t: The woman lifted her face, seemed about to say something, then immediately fell back into silence.

units.source_text: 说也没用，瞧那感觉就让人知道肯定是最坏的回答。

en.t: There was no point in saying anything; just from the feel of it, he knew the answer was bound to be the worst possible one.
